verdict.rationale: The source is publicly hosted at github.com/block/buzz, with raw source files and docs (crates, desktop, deploy) readable. First-party docs describe it as an "OSS codebase" and the repo as "OSS source — relay, desktop app, mobile app, CLI, agent harness", so the open-source claim is documented by the vendor. However, no evidence item names the license, and hands-on proof of open-licensed readability comes only from probes fetching files. missing for 10: the specific license name or a LICENSE file citation, independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
